main_text.head: HIER. ZANCHII ORATIO, DE CONSERVANDO IN ECCLESIA PURO PUTO Dei verbo, IN ACADEMIA HEI-delbergensi habita 12.13.& 15.Feb. Anno M.D.LXVIII.
Cùm in locum D. Zachariæ Ursini succedens professionem Locorum Communium publicè exordiretur.
main_text.p: DICTURUS sum, Clarissimi viri, & Ornatissimi auditores, de necessitate, deq; ratione retinendi purumque putum conservandi in Ecclesia verbum Dei: eóque nonnihil de officio Principum in hac re, Ecclesiarum, Pastorum, Doctorum, Studiosorum, deq; Scholarum antiquitate, utilitate & necessitate in regno Christi. Argumentum est, ut videtis, grave, honestum, utile, & vere etiam necessarium in hoc tempore: adde & mea conveniens ac consentaneum conditioni. Cùm enim mihi novo in hac celeberrima Academia Theologo, antequam meum munus obire incipiam, aliqua (ut moris est) habenda esset oratio, qua & Christianam

page.notes: The running head at the top is very faint and partly unclear; the letters after "CONS" and "NERV" are doubtful, so it is marked [?]. The faint text at the far left edge and the faint show-through of the other side are not transcribed. The first word has a large decorative D; it is joined to the rest of the word as DICTURUS. "tanèum" in the consentaneum line is read as printed, with the grave accent. The catchword "sapien-" is the start of the next page, and the signature "A" is at the foot centre.
